Dey Sarkar Residence

Complete 3,000 sq.ft. Home Interior – Foyer, Living, Dining, Kitchen & Bedrooms

A complete 3,000 sq.ft. home interior in Balurghat, from a sculptural foyer with a water wall and vertical garden to formal and family living rooms, a prayer niche, dining, kitchen and three bedrooms, each with its own character within a warm palette of timber, marble, sage and soft neutrals.

Location
Balurghat, West Bengal
Area
3000 sq.ft.
Type
Residential Interior
Style
Contemporary Luxury
Year
2025
Client
Bishu Dey Sarkar
About

Designed for Bishu Dey Sarkar in Balurghat, this 3,000 sq.ft. residence is a complete home interior, covering the foyer, a ground-floor formal living room, an upstairs family living room, a prayer niche, dining, kitchen and three bedrooms.

The home opens with a statement foyer: a carved entrance door, a cast-stone water wall, a vertical garden and a timber arched portal that frames the view inside. From there, each space takes on its own character. The formal living room is soft and curved with a statement chandelier fan, while the family living room upstairs is warmer, with an upholstered panel wall, brass accents and a corridor leading to a calm, arched prayer niche.

Dining and kitchen are planned as a connected unit, with a slatted timber ceiling and mirror wall over the dining table, a fully equipped U-shaped kitchen and a lit crockery unit between them. The three bedrooms each have a distinct mood, from the master bedroom's sculptural relief wall and walnut ceiling, to a botanical mural with a built-in study, to a calm wave-line feature wall.

Recurring arches, warm timber, marble and layered lighting tie the whole home together into one cohesive design.

A Sculptural Arrival
The foyer sets the tone for the whole home. A carved entrance door with flowing relief work opens onto a cast-stone water wall, a full-height vertical garden and a timber-clad arched portal with layered LED-lit reveals. A pair of abstract sculptures on a blush plinth frames the view into the living room, with a herringbone timber ceiling strip running overhead.
Ground-Floor Formal Living
The formal living room is soft and curved. An ivory curved sofa sits against a textured damask wallpaper wall with a timber-framed window, under a statement chandelier fan with teal blades and glass rods. Brass pendants, marble side tables and a pill-shaped fluted glass niche with a floating timber console complete the room, with a topographic-pattern feature wall behind the floating TV console.
Family Living
Upstairs, the family living room is warmer and more relaxed. A blush upholstered panel wall with an arched channel pattern sits beside a white fluted strip and a brass disc sconce. A grey sofa, ivory swivel armchair, slatted coffee table and geometric rug are framed by arched doors with diagonal grooves and brass inlays, and a black metal screen with circular inlays.
A Quiet Prayer Niche
At the end of the corridor, an arched niche with sage fluted backing and a soft LED edge holds a seated Buddha on a curved white console. Sage arch-outline panels with backlit circles line the walls, turning a passage into a calm, contemplative corner.
Dining Under Timber Beams
A six-seat terrazzo-top dining table with rust upholstered chairs sits beneath a slatted timber ceiling. A grid mirror wall reflects the kitchen and doubles the sense of space, flanked by white fluted panels and glass-disc wall sconces.
A Fully Equipped Kitchen
The U-shaped kitchen combines matt taupe base units, handleless white uppers with walnut accents and glass-front cabinets. A quartz worktop runs into a full-height backsplash around the angled chimney and hob, with a central prep table, wicker pull-out baskets, a double wall oven and a side-by-side fridge tower. A tall crockery unit with bronze glass doors and lit shelves links the kitchen to the dining area.
The Master Bedroom
The master bedroom is anchored by a backlit sculptural relief wall set in a walnut surround. A textured white headboard wall with arched relief tiles, a channel-tufted grey headboard and a brass sconce sit under a walnut ceiling with a wave-profile cove. Sage wardrobes with walnut arch and pill-shaped inlays frame a lit, fluted bronze glass centre unit.
A Botanical Bedroom with Study
The second bedroom pairs a softly backlit botanical mural with sculpted white panels and star cut-outs, behind a green channel-tufted headboard. A built-in study with a curved floating desk and lit book shelves is set into the wardrobe wall.
A Calm, Flowing Third Bedroom
The third bedroom is quiet and minimal. A cove-lit wave line divides a taupe and white feature wall above a textured channel headboard and floating side tables, beside a full-height white shaker wardrobe with a fluted band.
Highlights
Water Wall & Vertical Garden
A cast-stone water feature and living green wall greet guests at the entrance.
Every Room Designed
Foyer, two living rooms, prayer niche, dining, kitchen and three bedrooms in one scheme.
Signature Arches
Arched portals, doors, niches and inlays repeat throughout the home.
Statement Lighting
Chandelier fans, brass pendants, disc sconces and cove lighting in every space.
Rich Material Palette
Walnut, terrazzo, marble, fluted panels, brass and bronze glass.
Distinct Room Personalities
Each bedroom has its own mood, from sculptural relief to botanical mural to calm wave lines.
